source: Just released · FTA VAT Directive No. 8 of 2026 · 19 Nov 2026
headline: VENDING MACHINES?
NO TAX INVOICE

blocks.text: Keep, as a minimum, for every supply

items: **What:** a description of the goods or services
**How much:** total consideration received and VAT charged

blocks.text: **Vending machine:** automated self-service, no human input by the supplier. Restocking or maintenance doesn't count.
**Third-party operator?** Payment is deemed collected on the earlier of the operator's confirmation or the day after **30 days** from its collection.
